verdict.rationale: Shopify's AI assistant Sidekick can be asked in natural language to recommend stock transfers between locations and create them automatically, and it also offers reordering suggestions. This is real natural-language operation, but the evidence covers only inventory tasks and does not show it working inside the POS app itself. Missing for 10: natural-language control of core POS workflows (checkout, carts, discounts, fulfillment), evidence that Sidekick runs within the POS app rather than the admin, documentation of command scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
